default_system: You are a helpful and concise assistant.
exclusions: The SFT data's tool-calling format (hobbylm/tool_data.py) is a single-shot 'TOOLS: [...]\nUSER: ...\nASSISTANT:' completion with a raw JSON array of {name, arguments} and no training examples of multi-turn tool dialogue, parallel calls, or tool-result follow-up. The 10 calling cases below therefore test only single-shot, single-call selection from a short tool list; multi-call and multi-turn tool use are out of scope and excluded rather than scored as hidden failures.

Instruction-following cases test literal format/length/lexical constraints that are mechanically checkable (IFEval-style). They do not test factual correctness, reasoning quality, or style judgment, which would need a blinded human rubric this research pass does not attempt.
